fusions.name: Snap From Stillness
fusions.desc: A sudden snap that deals 12 damage and stuns the target for 1 second. It has 40% more critical chance against a target that has not yet been hurt.

fusions.name: Chill Underfoot
fusions.desc: Every enemy within 2.5 tiles takes 3 damage, with a 25% chance to become [Slowed] for 3 seconds. You move 10% faster for 2 seconds afterward.

fusions.name: Leave the Tail
fusions.desc: Removes up to 3 conditions from you, and you move 25% faster for 3 seconds afterward.

fusions.name: Sun-Warmed
fusions.desc: By day, you deal 10% more damage. Your dodge chance rises by 5% at all times.
